main_text.p: Lex, Æ. de quo plura apud Spelmannum nostrum, in voce Ꞔtwa. Videatur etiam Kilian. verb. ꞒꞒ. & Ꞔtwe. Legislator autem Sax. Ælæðenðe; ab Æ. lex, & læðan, ferre.
Ꞔtwethon, Æternum] Vide Kilian. verbo Ꞔeutwe.
main_text.head: Verba.
main_text.p: Ꞔbfon, Persequi. Ꞔbfon sal, Persequar. Ꞔbtindon, Persequentibus] Sax. eh̄tan, quod persequi significat, de quo supra in Ꞩbttdon. Sal autem hic, & in pluribus verbis tam præcedentibus quàm sequentibus, nota est verbi futuri temporis, cui respondet & Sax. rceal, & nostrum Ꞩhall, de quo vide Gryphiand.de Weichbild, Saxon.c.38. num.17.
main_text.head: F
main_text.p: Facinga, Dormitatio: nos Ꞩaecꞩ. vide Facon.
Fardtuncon, Crapulatus] Sax. hoc opfep-dʒuncon, unde nostrū dzunke, & dzunken, Belg. dzoncken; Teuton. trüncken, eo sensu.

page.notes: Old German glossary in black letter and Greek-like forms; several words in Anglo-Saxon type are uncertain and may be misread (e.g. "Ꞔtwa", "Ꞩbttdon", "dzuncon"). Marked forms are approximate.
